ASHWATHANARAYANA,

 HASANDAHALLI POST,

 ...RESPONDENTS  THIS MFA FILED U/S 173(1) OF MV ACT AGAINST THE JUDGMENT AND AWARD DATED 30.03.2024 PASSED IN MVC NO.24/2023 ON THE FILE OF THE I ADDITIONAL DISTRICT JUDGE AND MEMBER, MACT, KOLAR, AWARDING COMPENSATION OF RS.30,27,200/- WITH INTEREST AT 9 PERCENT P.A. FROM THE DATE OF PETITION TILL REALIZATION.

THIS APPEAL, COMING ON FOR ADMISSION, THIS DAY,
JUDGMENT WAS DELIVERED THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE DR. JUSTICE CHILLAKUR SUMALATHA
ORAL JUDGMENT Learned counsel Sri.A.M.Venkatesh submit that the matter is settled between the parties.
Learned counsel files a memo seeking permission to withdraw the appeal.
Permission as prayed for is accorded.
The amount, if any, in deposit be transmitted to the Tribunal.
NC: 2024:KHC:37440 Pending interlocutory application vide IA No.1/2021 also stands dismissed.
